goa-5.note: Seasonal on top of this: effectively Oct–Mar only. The Wednesday fact holds whenever the market runs at all. Season → K7.

goa-6.note: Seasonal on top of this: effectively Nov–Mar only, from 6 PM. Season → K7.

goa-22.note: Venue + VENUE, not venue + area — the church has a door too, so gating costs nothing. Two closures stack. Owner also gives 10 AM–4 PM as the useful arrival window so the museum is seen before it shuts; that is a last-useful-arrival fact → K1/4B.

kochi-2.note: The card names Palace AND Synagogue, and one card can carry only one schedule. Palace closes Fri; Synagogue closes Sat. Saturday is therefore lost even though the Palace is open — recovering it needs the card split, raised as T35.

Sun–Thu 10 AM–6 PM, Fri REDUCED 10 AM–2 PM, closed Sat and Jewish holidays. The reduced-Friday fact needs per-weekday hours → K1/4B. Stored per the owner's Note B instruction to keep venue schedules separate.

munnar-1.note: The card is "Munnar tea gardens & Tea Museum". The MUSEUM shuts on Monday; the tea gardens do not. Owner review #11.

munnar-9.note: Owner: factory tours and tastings run Tue–Sun, with most major estates and museums closed Monday. Unlike munnar-1 this card is the tour itself, not a garden day, so it gates.

mcleod-3.note: The card is "Tibet Museum & McLeod market"; the market runs every day, so the card is not gated (owner review #5). NOTE FOR ANYONE RE-CHECKING THIS: every listing aggregator says Monday. The museum's own site says SATURDAY. Prefer the official site.

mcleod-18.note: Campus, temple, café, shop and museum run Mon–Sun 9–5:30, but the WORKSHOPS — the reason to go — are closed Sunday AND the 2nd Saturday of every month. The 2nd-Saturday rule needs nth-weekday-of-month support → K1/4B; only the Sunday half is expressible here.

bangkok-10.note: MIGRATED from build-thailand.mjs, which carried the gate but no provenance. Value unchanged and asserted equal by the build guard. Fri 6 PM–midnight is wholesale only, deliberately not counted as open.

bangkok-13.note: MIGRATED from build-thailand.mjs. Amphawa floating market runs Fri–Sun 2–8 PM; Maeklong railway market itself is daily, but the card pairs them.

chiangmai-3.note: MIGRATED from build-thailand.mjs. The separate Saturday Walking Street (Wualai) is a different market and is not in the KB.

chiangmai-13.note: Casual Monk Chat at the MCU Chiang Mai campus runs Mon–Fri 4–7 PM; the university's structured sessions concentrate on Mon/Wed/Fri 5–7 PM. openDays describes the door, so all five weekdays. The Mon/Wed/Fri intensity is a programme fact → K1/4B.

samui-2.note: Owner: operates Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sun. Open-web sources split between "Friday only" and "most nights", which is why this could not land on research alone.

phuket-11.note: FantaSea runs Tue/Fri/Sun; Carnival Magic runs Mon/Wed/Sat; both dark Thursday. The two rotas are DISJOINT. This USED to be one card naming both shows gated to the UNION of the rotas [0,1,2,3,5,6] — so on every open night the card named a show that was dark, and the choice it offered was real on zero nights. The card is now SPLIT into two rows, each gated to its own rota, in one mutually-exclusive group. That is T35 applied to this pair.

phuket-11b.note: The FantaSea half of the split described on `phuket-11`. Dark Thursday, and dark on Carnival Magic's nights.

tokyo-6.note: Also closed on some national holidays, two 10-day maintenance periods (May, Nov), and local-resident days — all date-list closures → K1/4B.

tokyo-10.note: The card is "Ueno Park + Tokyo National Museum". Ueno Park is an AREA and is fine on a Monday, so the card is not gated — same shape the owner ruled on for Minato Mirai and the Munnar tea gardens.

tokyo-15.note: DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE. Wednesday is the market's standing day off; Sundays ALTERNATE on the Tokyo wholesale rota, which a flat weekday list cannot express, so all Sundays are excluded. This loses roughly half the Sundays it is genuinely open — chosen on purpose, because a 5 AM taxi to a shuttered tuna auction is a far worse morning. Residual public-holiday closures → K1/4B.

tokyo-20.note: The card is "Sumo museum / stable-area walk". Ryogoku is walkable any day and the owner ruled it should still be recommended at weekends; the museum is Mon–Fri (and open daily during Tokyo tournaments, a date-list fact → K1/4B).

tokyo-22.note: The card is "Minato Mirai + Cup Noodles Museum". Minato Mirai is an AREA — owner review #8, verbatim: "that's an area".

tokyo-24.note: MIGRATED from build-japan.mjs, which carried the gate but no provenance. Value unchanged and asserted equal by the build guard.

hokkaido-5.note: Closes Tuesday instead when Monday is a public holiday — a holiday-calendar fact → K1/4B.
